findings.description: The bucket has no acl set to private (defaults to public-read in this context per comment) and is explicitly noted as public, allowing unauthenticated users to read/list sensitive customer data stored in it.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects (including customer-master.xlsx) are stored unencrypted at rest, risking data exposure if underlying storage is compromised.
Versioning is not enabled, so objects can be overwritten or deleted without recovery, increasing risk of accidental or malicious data loss/tampering.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data in unencrypted public bucket
findings.description: This object (customer-master.xlsx, likely sensitive customer/financial data) is stored in the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket which is public and unencrypted, directly exposing sensitive data to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this financials bucket, leaving sensitive financial data unencrypted at rest.
No versioning block is configured, so financial records can be overwritten or deleted without the ability to recover prior versions, weakening data integrity protections.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so operational data stored in this bucket is not encrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so data science datasets are stored unencrypted at rest, which is a risk for potentially sensitive analytical data.
